scripts.pages:dev: bun run build && wrangler pages dev
scripts.verify:prerender: bun -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const checksByFile = { 'dist/index.html': ['Any Agents', 'Watch the troupe', 'One window for the whole troupe', 'Frequently asked'], 'dist/testimonial/submit/index.html': ['Tell developers how Troupe helps you.'], 'dist/privacy/index.html': ['Privacy — Troupe', '>Privacy', /Last updated:(?:| )*[A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}/, 'Google Tag Manager', 'https://usetroupe.dev/privacy/'], 'dist/terms/index.html': ['Terms — Troupe', '>Terms', /Last updated:(?:| )*[A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}/, 'MIT License', 'https://usetroupe.dev/terms/'], 'dist/404.html': ['Page not found'] }; const missing = []; for (const [file, checks] of Object.entries(checksByFile)) { const html = fs.existsSync(file) ? fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8') : ''; for (const s of checks) if (s instanceof RegExp ? !s.test(html) : !html.includes(s)) missing.push(file + ': ' + s); } if (fs.existsSync('dist/404/index.html')) missing.push('dist/404/index.html must not exist (would serve /404 as 200)'); if (fs.existsSync('dist/_redirects')) missing.push('dist/_redirects must not exist (SPA catch-all would turn 404s into soft 404s)'); if (missing.length) { console.error('Prerender check failed:', missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1); } console.log('Prerender check passed.');"
